chapterInfo.content:
23
Lewifoɔ som ho nhyehyɛɛ
1 # 1 Ah 1.28-40 Na Dawid bɔɔ akora pa ara no, ɔde ne ba Salomo sii Israel so hene.
2Na Dawid boaa Israel mmapɔmma nyinaa ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no ano hyiae. 3Na wɔkan Lewifoɔ no, nnipa a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduasa ne akyire no, na wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpemaduasa nwɔtwe. 4Yeinom mu mpemaduonu nnan na wɔnhwɛ AWURADE fie adwuma no soɔ, na mpemnsia nyɛ atwerɛfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ, 5na mpemnan nyɛ apono ano ahwɛfoɔ, na mpemnan nso mfa nnoɔma a meyɛ memaa ayeyie no nyi AWURADE ayɛ.
6 # 1 Be 6.16-17 Na Dawid kyekyɛɛ wɔn mu sɛdeɛ Lewi mma no teɛ: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.
7 # 1 Be 26.21 Gersonfoɔ ne: Ladan ne Simei. 8Ladan mma ne: Otitire Yehiel ne Setam ne Yoel, wɔyɛ baasa. 9Simei mma ne: Selomot ne Hasiel ne Haran, wɔyɛ baasa. Yeinom ne Ladan agyanom atitire. 10Na Simei mma ne: Yahat, Sisa, Yeus ne Beria. Yeinom ne Simei mma, wɔyɛ baanan. 11Na Yahat ne panin, na Sisa di hɔ, na Yeus ne Beria nni mma pii nti, wɔyɛɛ ɔkan mu agya fie baako.
12 # 1 Be 6.2-3 Kohat mma ne: Amram, Yishar, Hebron ne Usiel, wɔyɛ baanan. 13#1 Be 6.49; Heb 5.4; Deut 10.8 Amram mma ne: Aaron ne Mose. Na wɔyii Aaron sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ade kronkronkron no ho adeɛ, ɔno ne ne mma nkɔsi daa; sɛ wɔnhye aduhwam AWURADE anim, na wɔnsom, na wɔmfa ne din nhyira nkɔsi daa. 14#Deut 33.1 Na wɔbɔɔ Nyankopɔn nipa Mose mma din fraa Lewi abusuakuo no mu. 15#Eks 18.3-4 Mose mma ne: Gersom ne Eliesa. 16#1 Be 26.24 Gersom mma: Sebuel, otitire no. 17#1 Be 24.21-30 Na Eliesa mma: Rehabia, otitire no. Na Eliesa nni mma foforɔ, na Rehabia mma deɛ, na wɔdɔɔso pii. 18Yishar mma: Selomit ne panin. 19Hebron mma: Yeria ne panin, Amaria di hɔ, Yahasiel tɔ so mmiɛnsa, Yekameam tɔ so nnan. 20Usiel mma: Mika ne panin, na Yisia di hɔ.
21 # 1 Be 6.19 Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Mahli mma ne: Eleasa ne Kis. 22Na Eleasa wui, na ɔnni mmammarima, mmammaa nko ara na na ɔwɔ. Na wɔn nuanom Kis mma waree wɔn. 23Musi mma ne: Mahli, Eder ne Yeremot, wɔyɛ baasa.
24Yeinom ne Lewi mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, agyanom mu atitire, sɛ wɔkan wɔn mmaako mmaako sɛdeɛ wɔn din dodoɔ teɛ, a wɔyɛ AWURADE fie som adwuma no, wɔn a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduonu ne akyire. 25#Yoel 3.21 Na Dawid kaa sɛ: AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn ama me man ho adwo wɔn, na ɔte Yerusalem daa. 26Na Lewifoɔ no nso ansoa ntomadan no ne ne som ho nnoɔma no biara bio, 27ɛfiri sɛ Dawid nsɛm a ɛdi akyire no mu no, wɔkan Lewi mma no dodoɔ de firi deɛ wadi mfirinhyia aduonu soɔ de rekorɔ. 28Na wɔn adwuma ne sɛ wɔhwɛ Aaron mma no nsa ano, sɛ wɔnsom AWURADE fie n’abannwa so ne mpia no mu, na wɔmma akronkronneɛ no nyinaa ho mfi, na wɔnyɛ Nyankopɔn fie som adwuma, 29na wɔnyɛ kyerɛ paanoo ne esiam, aduane afɔdeɛ ne apiti taterɛ ne dadeɛ ayowa ne akyeduane ho adeɛ, na wɔnhwɛ ɔhyɛ adeɛ ne susuo adeɛ nyinaa so. 30#Dwom 92.2 Na wɔnnyina hɔ daa anɔpa nna ase, nyi AWURADE ayɛ, na anwummerɛ nso, saa ara, 31na wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nyinaa mma AWURADE, homeda ne bosome foforɔ ne afahyɛ mu, ne dodoɔ mu sɛdeɛ n’atorɔmuadeɛ teɛ daa, AWURADE anim, 32na wɔnyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho som adwuma, ne kronkronbea som adwuma ne wɔn nuanom Aaron mma som adwuma no, mfa nsom AWURADE fie.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Dawid bɔɔ akora pa ara no, ɔde ne ba Salomo sii Israel so hene.
Na Dawid boaa Israel mmapɔmma nyinaa ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no ano hyiae. Na wɔkan Lewifoɔ no, nnipa a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduasa ne akyire no, na wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpemaduasa nwɔtwe. Yeinom mu mpemaduonu nnan na wɔnhwɛ AWURADE fie adwuma no soɔ, na mpemnsia nyɛ atwerɛfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ, na mpemnan nyɛ apono ano ahwɛfoɔ, na mpemnan nso mfa nnoɔma a meyɛ memaa ayeyie no nyi AWURADE ayɛ.
Na Dawid kyekyɛɛ wɔn mu sɛdeɛ Lewi mma no teɛ: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.
Gersonfoɔ ne: Ladan ne Simei. Ladan mma ne: Otitire Yehiel ne Setam ne Yoel, wɔyɛ baasa. Simei mma ne: Selomot ne Hasiel ne Haran, wɔyɛ baasa. Yeinom ne Ladan agyanom atitire. Na Simei mma ne: Yahat, Sisa, Yeus ne Beria. Yeinom ne Simei mma, wɔyɛ baanan. Na Yahat ne panin, na Sisa di hɔ, na Yeus ne Beria nni mma pii nti, wɔyɛɛ ɔkan mu agya fie baako.
Kohat mma ne: Amram, Yishar, Hebron ne Usiel, wɔyɛ baanan. Amram mma ne: Aaron ne Mose. Na wɔyii Aaron sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ade kronkronkron no ho adeɛ, ɔno ne ne mma nkɔsi daa; sɛ wɔnhye aduhwam AWURADE anim, na wɔnsom, na wɔmfa ne din nhyira nkɔsi daa. Na wɔbɔɔ Nyankopɔn nipa Mose mma din fraa Lewi abusuakuo no mu. Mose mma ne: Gersom ne Eliesa. Gersom mma: Sebuel, otitire no. Na Eliesa mma: Rehabia, otitire no. Na Eliesa nni mma foforɔ, na Rehabia mma deɛ, na wɔdɔɔso pii. Yishar mma: Selomit ne panin. Hebron mma: Yeria ne panin, Amaria di hɔ, Yahasiel tɔ so mmiɛnsa, Yekameam tɔ so nnan. Usiel mma: Mika ne panin, na Yisia di hɔ.
Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Mahli mma ne: Eleasa ne Kis. Na Eleasa wui, na ɔnni mmammarima, mmammaa nko ara na na ɔwɔ. Na wɔn nuanom Kis mma waree wɔn. Musi mma ne: Mahli, Eder ne Yeremot, wɔyɛ baasa.
Yeinom ne Lewi mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, agyanom mu atitire, sɛ wɔkan wɔn mmaako mmaako sɛdeɛ wɔn din dodoɔ teɛ, a wɔyɛ AWURADE fie som adwuma no, wɔn a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduonu ne akyire. Na Dawid kaa sɛ: AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn ama me man ho adwo wɔn, na ɔte Yerusalem daa. Na Lewifoɔ no nso ansoa ntomadan no ne ne som ho nnoɔma no biara bio, ɛfiri sɛ Dawid nsɛm a ɛdi akyire no mu no, wɔkan Lewi mma no dodoɔ de firi deɛ wadi mfirinhyia aduonu soɔ de rekorɔ. Na wɔn adwuma ne sɛ wɔhwɛ Aaron mma no nsa ano, sɛ wɔnsom AWURADE fie n’abannwa so ne mpia no mu, na wɔmma akronkronneɛ no nyinaa ho mfi, na wɔnyɛ Nyankopɔn fie som adwuma, na wɔnyɛ kyerɛ paanoo ne esiam, aduane afɔdeɛ ne apiti taterɛ ne dadeɛ ayowa ne akyeduane ho adeɛ, na wɔnhwɛ ɔhyɛ adeɛ ne susuo adeɛ nyinaa so. Na wɔnnyina hɔ daa anɔpa nna ase, nyi AWURADE ayɛ, na anwummerɛ nso, saa ara, na wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nyinaa mma AWURADE, homeda ne bosome foforɔ ne afahyɛ mu, ne dodoɔ mu sɛdeɛ n’atorɔmuadeɛ teɛ daa, AWURADE anim, na wɔnyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho som adwuma, ne kronkronbea som adwuma ne wɔn nuanom Aaron mma som adwuma no, mfa nsom AWURADE fie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
